routes.name: Elm Fork Greenbelt Paddle
routes.notes: River paddle through the Elm Fork Greenbelt corridor. Float with current; state park pass or $7 fee required.

routes.name: Elm Fork Below Lewisville Dam

launch.name: LLELA Kayak Launch (201 E. Jones St., Lewisville)

exit.name: Hebron Pkwy Kayak Launch (1105 Hebron Pkwy)

routes.notes: Tailwater below Lewisville Dam. One-way downstream — arrange a shuttle at Hebron Pkwy. Check llela.org for current launch conditions.

routes.name: White Rock Creek Greenbelt
routes.notes: Creek paddle through White Rock Creek Greenbelt. Beautiful wooded corridor through Richardson and Dallas. Flows into White Rock Lake. Best at 50+ CFS.

routes.name: Lake Ray Hubbard Open Water
routes.notes: Flat-water lake paddle on Lake Ray Hubbard. Open water — wind is the main concern. Many coves to explore along the shoreline. Return trip or arrange shuttle.
